measurement: Each revision ran 120 moving, fresh poses per population on the same device. Each pose rebuilt geometry, visibility, transfer and lighting. ThroughBothMs is the per-pose maximum of GPU-complete readback and the identified compositor swap, measured from the edit. Camera work overlaps lighting. Display scales the 4K buffer. Physical scanout, driver, swap buffers and transient JS allocations are unmeasured. Optional optics blocked during timed replays. Physical reference paths and regional operator timings below are separate experiments.
roundedVisibility: whole interval certified by its extremes
curvedFacing: Individual receiving point and curved chart rejected before visibility
Receiving point and curved chart covered by a whole-domain horizon proof, counted when consuming the domain record

finiteCeilingFunction.geometry: Two slats; central floor area, central 1/16 of each ceiling axis (0.425 by 0.55625 metres). Direct and slat-reflected named paths. Existing wall fields use numerical quadrature.
finiteCeilingFunction.procedure: Compile a finite-domain last-leg kernel, evaluate on 17 x 17 positions, then individually integrate the two visible transport legs for each position using the same wall refinement. The interpolation bound excludes errors upstream and floating-point arithmetic.

additionalObservations.quarterWallAndReceiver: Receiver family scopes refer to fractions of authored half-axes. An edited layout can invalidate all-region visibility.

unusedDomainCandidate.description: A stronger scene-wide broad phase removed additional blocker tests but its preparation erased the savings in these short replays. Excluded from production.
